CPP_BITS_DECLARE_MSG0: Create a row of %1 bits named %2 copied from %3
CPP_BITS_DECLARE_TOOLTIP: A fixed-length row of bits, each holding 0 or 1. Leaving "copied from" empty starts every bit at 0. Read and write a position by index (counting from 0), or combine whole rows with bitwise operators. The length must be a fixed number; plugging in a variable will not compile.
